title: Lunch Before French
setting: A sunny green park with a path and a library behind it.

characters.name: Ben
characters.look: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts)

characters.name: Mia
characters.look: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans)

sentences.en: Ben and Mia go out in good weather.
sentences.zh: 天气很好，本和米娅出门了。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) step out of a house into bright sunny weather.

sentences.en: Ben wears his new green shirt.
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) proudly shows off his new green T-shirt.

sentences.en: They follow a path to the park.
sentences.zh: 他们沿着一条小路走到公园。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) walk along a path into a green park.

sentences.en: Ben gives Mia a big bowl of salad.
sentences.zh: 本给了米娅一大碗沙拉。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) hands a big bowl of green salad to Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) on the grass.

sentences.en: They both smile and eat the great salad.
sentences.zh: 他们俩都笑着吃这份很棒的沙拉。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) smile and eat salad from the bowl, both giving a thumbs up.

sentences.en: They do not want to miss French class.
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) looks at her watch and jumps up while Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) quickly packs the salad bowl.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Mia checking her watch and Ben packing up in a hurry; missing French class can't be shown.

sentences.en: So they run to the library behind the park.
sentences.zh: 于是他们跑向公园后面的图书馆。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) run toward a library building behind the park trees.

sentences.en: Inside, they practise each French word twice.
sentences.zh: 在里面，他们把每个法语单词都练了两遍。
sentences.scene_prompt: Inside a library, Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) sit at a table and read aloud together from a book with a French flag on the cover.
